<description>
Fixes #25150

APS (Avoid Partial Spends) runs a second coin selection pass that spends many
(possibly all) or none of the UTXOs sharing a scriptPubKey. The second pass runs
even when the first selection left no partial spend for it to avoid, and
aps_create_tx_internal then reports APS as used whenever the grouped result is
taken, overreporting how often a partial spend was avoided.

Detect partial spends by comparing selected vs available UTXO counts per
scriptPubKey, reusing the coins already fetched for selection and counting
manually selected inputs towards their scriptPubKey. Skip APS if none found.

Functional tests cover APS being skipped and a manually selected input making
the spend partial.

---

*Supersedes #34362.*
</description>
